hardQuoteObservations.preregisteredQuote: Anniversary T-Bone Steak with Sparkling Toast All-You-Can-Drink Course (6 Dishes)

Celebrate with a special T-bone steak course, starting with a sparkling toast. Enjoy a satisfying six-course meal featuring two appetizers, pasta, our signature T-bone steak, and seasonal sorbet. This package includes a two-hour all-you-can-drink option, making it perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, or special meals with loved ones. *Price: JPY 10,000 (tax included) per person.
[For Welcome and Farewell Parties, Drinking Parties, etc.!] ilco 2-Hour All-You-Can-Drink Course!

The course features a generous selection of seven dishes, making it perfect for welcome and farewell parties, girls' nights out, and various other banquets! Available for groups starting from just three people! For an additional JPY 1,100 per person, you can extend the all-you-can-drink option by 30 minutes! We can accommodate private reservations for parties of around 40 guests. Wine tasting events with your own wine are also warmly welcomed! Please feel free to consult us regarding your budget and any other inquiries.

The course includes a total of six dishes and is available for groups of four or more! It's perfect for various banquets such as welcome and farewell parties or girls' nights out! The all-you-can-drink option is available for 90 minutes.
